whyItMatters: java response headers assemble from parts (setHeaders*([^)]*+), so CRLF in input splits the response.
actions: Validate the value with a token-charset allowlist, rejecting CR, LF, and unexpected bytes.
Prefer framework header APIs that encode or reject control bytes.
Re-run the scan and confirm no raw header assembly remains.
verification: Rescan shows no raw header assembly, and CRLF probes are rejected.
